T1_nested_closed_approximants.statement: Recursive identity can be represented by nested closed finite approximants inside one fixed profile domain.

T2_resolution_matching.statement: Two identities may be indistinguishable through active depth R while diverging at deeper Resolution.

T3_profile_not_complete_identity.statement: Projection-profile agreement at finite Resolution is an identity witness/readout, not proof of complete ontological equality.

T4_unbounded_fractal_not_required.statement: Recursive depth may increase without spatial extent increasing; the identity carrier can remain bounded/closed.
